scripts.mongodb:test: npm run mongodb:frontend:test && node shared/scripts/mvnw.mjs -pl plugins/mongodb/backend -am verify
scripts.mongodb:frontend:test: npm run typecheck -w @queryeer-plugins/mongodb-frontend && npm run test -w @queryeer-plugins/mongodb-frontend
scripts.mongodb:build: node shared/scripts/mvnw.mjs -pl plugins/mongodb/backend -am clean package -DskipTests && npm run build -w @queryeer-plugins/mongodb-frontend
scripts.mongodb:package: npm run mongodb:build && node shared/scripts/package-plugin.mjs plugins/mongodb && npm run mongodb:verify
scripts.mongodb:verify: node shared/scripts/verify-package.mjs plugins/mongodb --expect-jar queryeer-mongodb-plugin- --expect-jar mongodb-driver-sync- --expect-jar mongodb-driver-core- --expect-jar bson-
scripts.mysql:test: npm run mysql:frontend:test && node shared/scripts/mvnw.mjs -pl plugins/mysql/backend -am verify
scripts.mysql:frontend:test: npm run typecheck -w @queryeer-plugins/mysql-frontend && npm run test -w @queryeer-plugins/mysql-frontend
scripts.mysql:build: node shared/scripts/mvnw.mjs -pl plugins/mysql/backend -am clean package -DskipTests && npm run build -w @queryeer-plugins/mysql-frontend
scripts.mysql:package: npm run mysql:build && node shared/scripts/package-plugin.mjs plugins/mysql && npm run mysql:verify
